title: Add an HTTP endpoint with tests
summary: Adds one route to the existing server, plus tests that call it over HTTP.
goal: Add an HTTP endpoint {method} {path} to the existing server. It should {behaviour}. Keep every existing route working. Add tests in {test_dir}/ that call the new route over HTTP and also cover a bad request.

params.name: behaviour
params.label: What it does
params.default: return a JSON object with status ok
